title: Assemble a stage tower while retaining every truncation
statement: Let X be qcqs, K a simplicial étale object over X, and A_n compatible finite split replacement stages over K with literal restriction equalities. There exist a full finite split étale hypercover V, a simplicial map f:V→K, and equalities trunc_n(V)=(A_n).U such that trunc_n(f) is the stage map transported by those equalities.

proof.text: Glue the simplicial tower using towerGlue. Glue stage maps degreewise and use stage compatibility for naturality. The finite-truncation equalities identify each glued degree with the corresponding stage degree. Transport the stage nondegenerate objects, splitting cofans, matching universal properties and matching covers through these equalities. The stage inclusion and refinement congruence formulas prove all required identities. The retained degreewise formula for the glued map gives the final truncation compatibility.

theorem exists_hypercover_of_stage_tower_with_truncation
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    (K : SimplicialObject X.Etale)
    (A : ∀ n, FiniteSplitReplacementStage K n)
    (e : ∀ n, (A (n + 1)).restrict n (Nat.le_succ n) = A n) :
    ∃ V : FiniteSplitEtaleHypercover X,
      ∃ (f : V.simplicial ⟶ K)
        (hV : ∀ n, (SimplicialObject.truncation n).obj V.simplicial = (A n).U.simplicial),
        ∀ n, (SimplicialObject.truncation n).map f = eqToHom (hV n) ≫ (A n).f
